visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned inside a departing subway train, looking through the glass of the closed doors. Outside on the platform, a woman with brownish-blonde hair is seen through the reflection and glass, laughing hysterically and waving as she is left behind. The doors feature yellow warning signs with a silhouette of a person tripping and text in Korean and English. (2) The scene cuts to the subway station platform where a woman with long, straight black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a plaid skirt, is bending over while laughing at her phone. She stands in a brightly lit, modern station with tiled floors and posters. Other commuters are visible walking in the background, out of focus. (3) The perspective shifts back inside the train, focusing on a woman with long dark hair talking on her smartphone. She is wearing a white top and a black crossbody bag. The background shows the train's interior map and handles, with bright, flat overhead lighting and metal surfaces. (4) The train doors, decorated with circular patterns and 'Caution' signs, slowly slide open at a new station. As they part, the woman who was previously left behind is standing directly in front of the opening, holding a water bottle and her phone while wearing a red halter top and blue jeans. (5) The two friends reunite inside the train, both smiling widely and laughing. The woman in the red top brushes her hair back from her forehead with her hand. The background is the interior of the train car, filled with other passengers and structural poles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, breathless female laughter breaks through the low-frequency hum of a moving subway train. The laughter is high-arousal and sharp in pitch, accompanied by the metallic, rhythmic clicking of tracks and the mechanical whoosh of the train accelerating. (2) A sharp acoustic cut leads to an environment with more reverb. A female voice shouts in an excited, high-pitched tone, followed by intense laughter that shows significant pitch variability. Background chatter from other commuters is faintly audible as distant, low-bandwidth noise. (3) The audio switches to a cleaner, enclosed indoor room tone. A female voice speaks into a phone with clear articulation and moderate conversational volume, maintaining a friendly and slightly amused tone while the train's electrical hum remains constant in the background. (4) A loud, percussive chime signals the train's arrival, followed by the motorized sliding sound of doors opening. High-pitched female laughter resumes, overlapping with excited greetings. The voices are joyful with rising intonations, mixed with the rustle of clothing and nearby movement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a humorous travel mishap where a friend accidentally gets left behind on a subway platform, capturing their emotional reaction and eventual joyful reunion.
